profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Data Science Intern
positions.description:
Streamlined data pipeline for video analysis and logo prediction, resulting in a 33% speedup.
Began implementation of a facial recognition tool using neural nets.
Designed and built a tool to monitor client streams on Twitch.

positions.title: QC Analyst
positions.description:
Analyzed client documents for critical information used to efficiently organize the documents.
Processed incoming documents so that they were easily accessible electronically.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Molecular biology research with Dr. Manojkumar Puthenveedu and his lab.
Researched protein-protein interactions by searching for necessary background information in addition to planning and carrying out experiments. Various lab techniques included transformation, protein induction and extraction, column chromatography, and SDS-Page.
Created weekly presentations on research progress and culminated research in formal report.

positions.title: Water Safety Instructor and Lifeguard
positions.description:
Taught both private and group swim lessons and was responsible for the safety and welfare of the pool guests.
Opened and closed the pools as well as basic maintenance of the facility.

honors.title: CSCAA Scholar All America
honors.description: Maintained a minimum GPA of 3.5 or higher and competed at the NCAA Division III Swimming and Diving National Championships.
honors.issuer: Issued by College Swimming Coaches Association of America · Jun 2018

volunteerExperiences.description: Organized the Olympic Village for Western PA Spring Sectionals, hosted at Carnegie Mellon University.
Volunteer weekly at a local elementary school.
